note: From the Priority50 sheet of panhispanic_paniberian_acquisitions.xlsm. Ranks are editorial recommendations, NOT commissioning decisions - every decision field in the source reads Unreviewed and "accepted for commissioning" is 0. Suggested titles are suggestions. Proposed introducers and editors are deliberately not included: they are real scholars who have agreed to nothing.

books.author: José Enrique Rodó Piñeyro
books.title: Ariel
books.suggested_english_title: Ariel: Culture, Democracy, and the Americas
books.text_focus: A spiritual-aesthetic education for democratic youth; critique of utilitarian modernity without a full federal program.

books.author: Manuel Baldomero Ugarte
books.title: El destino de un continente
books.suggested_english_title: The Destiny of a Continent: Latin America and the Struggle for Unity

books.author: Ramiro de Maeztu y Whitney
books.title: Defensa de la Hispanidad
books.suggested_english_title: In Defence of Hispanidad: Faith, Empire, and a Divided Inheritance

books.author: José Julián Martí Pérez
books.title: Nuestra América
books.suggested_english_title: Our America: Sovereignty, Race, and the New World

books.author: António Sardinha
